project_type: Cross-platform desktop app: Tauri v2 (Rust core) + React/TypeScript (Vite) frontend. Cargo workspace under hybrid-orchestrator/.
build_system: Cargo workspace at /projects/agent-harbor/hybrid-orchestrator. QUIRK: only the dependency-free `routing` crate is a `[workspace] members` entry (offline-buildable); every crate carrying crates.io deps is under `[workspace] exclude` and built explicitly in CI via `--manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Excluded crates pin concrete dep version literals (NOT {workspace=true}) because they have no workspace root to inherit from. Frontend uses npm + Vite + vitest + ESLint + Prettier.
test_framework: Rust: built-in cargo test with #[tokio::test] async tests and tests/ integration dirs. Mock ChatProvider (scripted responses) + bundled cross-platform mock MCP server [[bin]] spawned over stdio via env!(CARGO_BIN_EXE_...). Frontend: vitest.
build_command: From hybrid-orchestrator: `cargo build --workspace` (offline members only). Per-excluded-crate: `cargo build --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`.
test_command: From hybrid-orchestrator: `cargo test --workspace`; per excluded crate `cargo test --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml`. Frontend: `npm run test` from frontend/.
verification_instructions: OFFLINE (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY): crates.io/npm return 403. Cannot compile crates.io-dep crates or run clippy/build for them offline. CAN run `cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/<crate>/Cargo.toml --check` (rustfmt needs no network) for every touched crate, and CAN run a global `prettier --check .` from frontend/ (NODE_OPTIONS= prettier --check .). Real build/test/clippy of routing + orchestrator-core + tauri-app + frontend happens in CI. Self-audit against clippy -D warnings lints listed in environment_constraints.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Cargo.lock and frontend/package-lock.json are committed lockfiles; package-lock.json is generated by first networked CI run (npm ci || npm install). Do not add to gitignore.
setup_instructions: git checkout -b phase-4-routing-pipeline off main (commit bccd1bc). Work under /projects/agent-harbor/hybrid-orchestrator. No package install possible offline.
environment_constraints: Network mode INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no crates.io/npm, no external HTTP, Tauri CLI not installed. Cannot compile any crate carrying crates.io deps offline; those are CI-verified. rustfmt and a global prettier ARE runnable offline. CLIPPY -D warnings LINTS THAT REPEATEDLY BROKE PRIOR PHASES (self-audit up front): unused imports; dead_code (only scoped #[allow(dead_code)] with a 'wired in Phase N' note for genuinely-unused items); clippy::useless_vec (use array literals where a Vec is not needed); collapsible_if / collapsible_match; needless Debug-format of non-Debug/trait-object types (derive Debug on structs whose tests use {:?}; NEVER Debug-format a trait object); clippy::doc_overindented_list_items (doc-comment markdown list continuation lines must be indented ~3 spaces after `//!` to the list-item content, NOT aligned under prose - audit ALL new/edited doc comments). Also: internally-tagged serde enums need PER-VARIANT #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")] (enum-level does NOT cascade); add #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if=...)] for empty Vec/Option where an absent key is intended; keep the TS mirror in frontend/src/types/index.ts in EXACT sync (single-line unions if <=100 cols) and verify with prettier.
contribution_requirements: Pin concrete dep version literals in excluded crates (no {workspace=true}). Add per-crate fmt/build/clippy(-D warnings)/test steps to the routine `build` CI job in dependency order. Matrix is [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest] ONLY - do NOT add macOS, do NOT un-gate tauri-bundle. Keep the hybrid-orchestrator/Cargo.toml comments and .github/workflows/ci.yml comments consistent with the established exclude/EXIT-PATH pattern. Update README 'Implementation status' to flip Phase 4 to DONE.
key_patterns: Domain DTOs (ManualRoute, PrivacyTag {LocalOnly,Confidential,Custom(String)}, RouteSource {Manual,ConversationPin,Automatic}, AgentPersona{default_route,routing_hint}, RouteMetadata, TokenUsage) live in the leaf `domain` crate and are REUSED, not duplicated - routing must depend on `domain` and reconcile with these. providers crate exposes: ChatProvider async trait (chat + chat_stream->BoxStream<ChatDelta>), ChatRequest{model,messages:Vec<ChatMessage>,tools:Vec<ToolSpec>,temperature,max_tokens,stream,extra}, ChatResponse{choices,usage:Option<Usage>,model}, ChatChoice{message,finish_reason:Option<FinishReason>}, FinishReason{Stop,Length,ToolCalls,ContentFilter}, ChatMessage{role:MessageRole,content:Option<String>,tool_calls:Vec<ToolCall>,tool_call_id,name} with ::text() ctor, ToolCall{id,kind,function:FunctionCall{name,arguments:String}}, Capabilities{streaming,tools,vision,json_mode,max_context}, AvailableModel{provider_id,model,capabilities,price:TokenPrice}, TokenPrice{input_per_mtok,output_per_mtok,::ZERO}, ProviderRegistry(.get(id)->Option<Arc<dyn ChatProvider>>, .build_all, insert_instance), builtin_registry(), build_registry(configs,secrets). orchestrator-core: SessionManager (append_message, get_conversation, list_messages, set_conversation_route, personas()), CoreEvent 11-variant enum (MessageDelta{conversation_id,message_id,delta}, MessageComplete{...,status,route:Option<RouteMetadata>,usage:Option<TokenUsage>}, MessageError{...,message}), ToolBridge::new(servers,gate,events).attach_tools(&mut req)/handle_tool_call(&ToolCall)->ChatMessage (never Err; structured tool errors), PermissionGate/PermissionRegistry/Decision, Message/MessageContent/Role/MessageStatus. tauri-app: AppState{session_manager,secret_store,core_events:UnboundedSender<CoreEvent>,permission_registry}, commands.rs uses factored-out _inner fns driven by tests without live Tauri State; commands registered in lib.rs generate_handler!. persistence AppConfig{active_routing_policy:Option<String>, pricing:PricingConfig}, PricingConfig{per_kind,per_model} -> converted to providers::PricingTable via pricing_table_from_config in commands.rs.
directory_structure: hybrid-orchestrator/ holds the Cargo workspace (crates/) + frontend/. crates/: domain (leaf DTOs), orchestrator-core (session mgr, events, permission, tools_bridge, pipeline PLACEHOLDER), providers (ChatProvider + adapters + registry + builtins), mcp-client (MCP client + McpServerHandle + mock_server bin), routing (PLACEHOLDER - Phase 4 target), persistence (SQLite Db + config/pricing), secrets, tauri-app (Tauri shell: state/commands/events/lib/main). frontend/src: types/index.ts (TS mirror), ipc/commands.ts + events.ts. Specs in .kiro/specs/hybrid-orchestrator/.
